1: sannyāsaṁ karmaṇāṁ kṛiṣhṇa punar yogaṁ cha śhansasi |
yach chhreya etayor ekaṁ tan me brūhi su-niśhchitam ||
3: jñeyaḥ sa nitya-sannyāsī yo na dveṣhṭi na kāṅkṣhati |
nirdvandvo hi mahā-bāho sukhaṁ bandhāt pramuchyate ||
4: sānkhya-yogau pṛithag bālāḥ pravadanti na paṇḍitāḥ |
5: yat sānkhyaiḥ prāpyate sthānaṁ tad yogair api gamyate |
ekaṁ sānkhyaṁ cha yogaṁ cha yaḥ paśhyati sa paśhyati ||
6: sannyāsas tu mahā-bāho duḥkham āptum ayogataḥ |
8: naiva kiñchit karomīti yukto manyeta tattva-vit |
pralapan visṛijan gṛihṇann unmiṣhan nimiṣhann api |
9: pralapan visṛjan gṛhṇann unmiṣan nimiṣann api indriyāṇīndriyārtheṣu vartanta iti dhārayan ||
10: brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ |
lipyate na sa pāpena padma-patram ivāmbhasā ||
11: kāyena manasā buddhyā kevalair indriyair api |
12: yuktaḥ karma-phalaṁ tyaktvā śhāntim āpnoti naiṣhṭhikīm |
13: nava-dvāre pure dehī naiva kurvan na kārayan ||
14: na kartṛitvaṁ na karmāṇi lokasya sṛijati prabhuḥ |
15: nādatte kasyachit pāpaṁ na chaiva sukṛitaṁ vibhuḥ |
16: jñānena tu tad ajñānaṁ yeṣhāṁ nāśhitam ātmanaḥ |
teṣhām āditya-vaj jñānaṁ prakāśhayati tat param ||
18: śhuni chaiva śhva-pāke cha paṇḍitāḥ sama-darśhinaḥ ||
19: ihaiva tair jitaḥ sargo yeṣhāṁ sāmye sthitaṁ manaḥ |
nirdoṣhaṁ hi samaṁ brahma tasmād brahmaṇi te sthitāḥ ||
20: na prahṛiṣhyet priyaṁ prāpya nodvijet prāpya chāpriyam |
22: ye hi sansparśha-jā bhogā duḥkha-yonaya eva te |
ādyantavantaḥ kaunteya na teṣhu ramate budhaḥ ||
23: kāma-krodhodbhavaṁ vegaṁ sa yuktaḥ sa sukhī naraḥ ||
27: sparśhān kṛitvā bahir bāhyānśh chakṣhuśh chaivāntare bhruvoḥ |
vigatechchhā-bhaya-krodho yaḥ sadā mukta eva saḥ ||
28: yatendriya-mano-buddhir  munir   mokṣa-parāyaṇaḥ vigatecchā-bhaya-krodho yaḥ sadā    mukta   eva saḥ ||
29: suhṛidaṁ sarva-bhūtānāṁ jñātvā māṁ śhāntim ṛichchhati ||
